title: Pool cover with proposed alarm systems as a pool barrier (s162C)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE Chief Executive determination; Building Act 2004; comparative only, not Alberta)
code_edition: Building Act 2004 s162C; ASTM F1346-91 referred to through earlier determination 2018/005; NZ Building Code (cited); edition not stated

facts.text: The barrier under consideration is an existing automatic pool cover, with two alternative alarm systems proposed to supplement it.
Figure 1 is a photograph of the pool with the cover closed (p.1); Figure 2 is an aerial view of the pool with the cover closed (p.4).
The determination builds on 2018/005, which concluded that automatic covers compliant with ASTM F1346-91 but without any other physical barrier or immediate pool-area barrier do not meet F9 or s162C.
The matter is whether the existing cover alone, and then with either proposed alarm, complies as a barrier to the extent required under s162C of the Building Act 2004.
